title: Americans’ Use of Internet, Broadband in 2026
summary: The internet represents a fundamental shift in how Americans connect with one another, gather information and conduct their day-to-day lives. Explore the patterns, trends and statistics of internet and home broadband adoption in the United States.

summary: Today YouTube and Facebook are the most-widely used online platforms. Explore the demographic patterns and trends shaping the social media landscape.

summary: Americans today are increasingly connected to the world of digital information while “on the go” via smartphones. Explore the latest patterns, trends and statistics that have shaped the mobile revolution.

title: 1 in 5 Americans Regularly Get News on TikTok

summary: Democratic congressional candidates have a sizable advantage among Latino registered voters. And Latino Democratic candidate supporters are more engaged with this year’s election compared with four years ago.

title: The Gender Gap in AI
summary: Men and women now use AI chatbots at similar rates, but men use them more often, while women are more skeptical of AI's impact on their lives.

title: Republicans’ Views of Some Countries and International Organizations Differ Widely by Age
summary: Younger Republicans’ views of some countries and international organizations are sometimes closer to Democrats’ views than they are to those of older Republicans.

title: How Do Americans Feel About G20 Countries?
summary: Ahead of this year's G20 summit, most Americans rate Australia, Canada, Japan, Italy and other members warmly. Sentiment is coldest toward Russia.
